purpose: Verified contract for rendering authoritative source references for citizens.

public_contract.legal_claim: Show the applicable official legal source and exact provision where available.
public_contract.property_fact: Show the relevant official property-record identity or official retrieval route; do not expose unnecessary personal data.
public_contract.procedure: Show the responsible official body and its official route.
public_contract.historical_claim: Show the source/version applicable to the requested historical period.
public_contract.limitation: State when the source establishes only part of the proposition or access is restricted.

source_boundaries: An official service page can establish an official route without establishing a property-specific fact.
A folio/search can establish registered facts within its scope but does not automatically resolve every beneficial, historical or boundary issue.
A Registry of Deeds memorial/search can identify registration evidence but does not by itself establish the full substantive effect of an underlying deed.
Official guidance may explain process but does not override legislation.
verification_boundary: Rendering a citation does not independently establish the underlying claim; the citation must already have passed the source navigator, evidence/legal analysis and quality gate.
